title: `TIMESTAMP` is nanoseconds; sverify writes `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)`
verdict: `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)` by default; casts to 6 digits truncate; `DATEADD` widens to 9
description: `TIMESTAMP` maps to `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)` (`TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING`). A cast to `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)` truncates: `.9999999` becomes `.999999`. `DATEADD(MICROSECOND, 1, x)` of a `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)` is a `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)`, exact. `DATEDIFF(MICROSECOND, a, b)` is exact; coarser units count boundaries (`DATEDIFF(SECOND, '…:00.999999', '…:01.000001')` is 1).
`DATE_PART(EPOCH_MICROSECOND, x)` and `TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(n, 6)` convert exactly, before 1970 too. `DATE_PART` has no `MILLISECOND` or `MICROSECOND`; `EXTRACT(NANOSECOND …)` does.
reference: Timestamps are microseconds. sverify's SQL writes `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)` literals, adds and subtracts microseconds with `DATEADD` and `DATEDIFF`, and builds milliseconds and microseconds from `SECOND` and `NANOSECOND` (`writer-date-part`, `writer-time-micros`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::DATETIME), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_LTZ), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_TZ), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::DATE), SYSTEM$TYPEOF('2024-01-05 10:00:00'::TIME)
evidence.observed: (TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)[SB16], TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)[SB16], TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)[SB16], TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)[SB8], TIMESTAMP_LTZ(9)[SB16], TIMESTAMP_TZ(9)[SB16], DATE[SB4], TIME(9)[SB8])

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
